acquisition_modes.downloaded: sha-256 of the downloaded artifact itself. it proves the pinned file stored in this repository has not changed since it was retrieved from the source url on the recorded retrieval date. it says nothing about whether the source has since revised or withdrawn the series
acquisition_modes.manual_record: record integrity only. this is the sha-256 of this repository's local json record file, not of anything external. it proves the recorded value has not been edited since it was written here. it is NOT evidence that the original web page, catalog or pdf still contains the same value, and it cannot become such evidence. re-checking the source is a manual step that produces a new record

read_this_first: the two acquisition modes carry hashes that mean different things, and the difference matters. a downloaded artifact's hash is source integrity: it proves the pinned file has not changed since it was retrieved. a manual record's hash is record integrity ONLY: it proves this repository's written record of a hand-read value has not been edited. it does NOT prove that the original web page, catalog or pdf still contains that value. do not cite a record-integrity hash as evidence about the state of an external source
logistics_notes: every tariff record carries tariff_metadata with vat_status, effective_date, currency_as_published, unit_basis, service_category and fuel_surcharge_treatment, each with the source's own wording
'not stated in source' means the source was read and does not state the field; 'not verified' means the source could not be read at all
fuel_surcharge records are evidence of published mechanisms and percentages. none of them is a per-agent value, and no common value is implied
